scripts.dev: wt -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run dev:server" ; split-pane -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run dev:mobile"
scripts.tunnel: wt -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run dev:server" ; split-pane -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run tunnel:mobile"
scripts.usb:reverse: node -e "const{execSync}=require('child_process');const p=require('path').join(process.cwd(),'.tools','platform-tools','adb.exe');const Q=String.fromCharCode(34);try{for(const q of [8081,4000])execSync(Q+p+Q+' reverse tcp:'+q+' tcp:'+q,{stdio:'inherit'})}catch(e){console.warn('adb reverse не выполнен:',e.message)}"
scripts.preusb: npm run db:init && npm run usb:reverse
scripts.usb: wt -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run dev:server" ; split-pane -d . powershell -NoExit -Command "npm run usb:mobile"
